Information Retrieval (IR) is the field of finding relevant documents from a collection in response to a query. Key metrics include Precision (fraction of retrieved docs that are relevant), Recall (fraction of relevant docs that are retrieved), Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR, average of 1/rank across queries), Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain (NDCG, graded relevance with position discount), and Hit Rate (whether any relevant result appears in the top k). Modern IR systems combine lexical methods like TF-IDF and BM25 with neural methods like dense passage retrieval for state-of-the-art results.
